editorial.blurb: A legendary wood-fired Korean BBQ hotspot where premium Wagyu and Kobe beef meet old-school Japanese Yakiniku tradition, grilled tableside by your own hands.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead to reserve—this place fills up fast, especially on weekends. Arrive early if you're dropping in, and plan to spend $50+ per person to leave satisfied; think of it more like an izakaya experience than a typical restaurant.
